typed_surface.rule: Only semantic actor/from/to ordering and original turn ordinal. Distinct room players/actionIds do not need byte equivalence
Correctly align red/black side and turn/stage; compare the public projection actually seen and label lawful differences, not wholesale JSON
Before an actual lawful reveal, never expose an unrevealed true kind. At lawful reveal/death effects compare permission, effects and observed value; not an a priori equality assertion
Messages and action history may include actual lawful reveals/deaths and event order; check serialization to both players, not authority journals
Bound to actual player identity, not source actor; owner-only fields must not be copied into opponent view. Fixed chosen hero facts cannot justify secret piece leaks
For this H04/H03 pair do not assume traps are always present; if fields exist follow authenticated owner only
Actual caller-visible success/duplicate/error serialization and ordering must be separately captured. No inferred product error codes
Actual UI/client channels are not proven by remote-room.ts alone; nontrivial differences must be reviewed not normalized away
Distinct rooms/players/times cannot be compared literally; any normalization requires proof field is not carrying secret-state information
Controlled internal evidence only; comparisons to player outputs detect leak, not disclose source secrets or raw fixture values

source_code_evidence.public_room: src/remote-room.ts publicRemoteRoom lines1433-1455; state publicStateSnapshot, features, phase, rps, messages, terminalAnimation and other public fields
source_code_evidence.serialization: src/remote-room.ts serializePublicRemoteRoom lines1457-1459 (not confirmation of external delivery)
source_code_evidence.owner_auth: src/room.ts sideForPlayer lines26-30, authenticated playerId matches room.game.players
source_code_evidence.no_client_proof: No proven client code, transport serialization of errors, buttons, legality hints or rule-authorized normalization from these functions alone

pair_source_readiness.evidence_only: 2 pairs × 7 steps × 2 exact semantic boundaries × 2 viewer sides = 56 future per-view comparison slots; 112 underlying per-world per-view snapshots would be needed, none exists
pair_source_readiness.guard: Equal semantic move requests and declared expected result is NOT raw view equality nor legality or privacy pass. Distinct rooms/IDs/times must not be ignored without proof; rightful reveal outcomes may differ.
pair_source_readiness.original_secret: Pair worlds differ at 2 initial true-kind stable slots each. Only disclose count and source references here, not confidential true-kind mappings; all original witnesses remain source-only and no raw engine secret gets sent to player.
